name: What's the difference between a pre-fabricated shower and a custom-tiled shower?

mainEntity.name: What's the difference between a pre-fabricated shower and a custom-tiled shower?

acceptedAnswer.text: The main difference between pre-fabricated and custom-tiled showers lies in their construction and design flexibility. Pre-fabricated showers are typically single or multi-piece units made from acrylic or fiberglass, offering quick installation and often a lower upfront cost. Custom-tiled showers, on the other hand, are built on-site using a waterproof base and individual tiles, allowing for extensive personalization in design, size, and material, though they generally require more time and a higher investment. Your choice depends on budget, desired aesthetic, and project timeline.
acceptedAnswer.description: Pre-fabricated showers are quick, cost-effective units, while custom-tiled showers offer extensive design personalization but require more time and investment. The choice depends on budget, aesthetics, and timeline.
